To: All employees at Manoukian A ccounting
From: Jared Croce, Office Manager

Date: September 28

Subject: Update

We are now in the process of updating employee work spaces. - [1] -. All
of the fixed-height desks and chairs will be replaced with adjustable-height
standing desks and active-position chairs.

The new work configurations will allow employees to switch easily from
sitting to standing and then back again. - [2] -. Everyone will also
receive new energy-efficient desk lamps. - [3] -. Officewide use of these
new lamps will allow us to reduce our reliance on overhead ceiling lights,
lowering overall energy costs by 10 percent. - [4] -.
